---
type: regex
pattern: '"unique-id"\s*:\s*"192-0-2-9"'
match: count:1
target: {source: file, path: testing/external-systems.calm.json}
---
The node for 192.0.2.9, the metrics collector reached over UDP is there once, with the id the skill's rule gives (the host with every character but letters and digits turned into `-`). The closing quote keeps its interface ids (`192-0-2-9-<port>`) from counting.
